notes.erector_note: Top lift guardrail posts extended 0.2 m.

deciding.design_conformity: Height 10.2 m is 0.2 m over the 10.0 m maximum with no variation. The erector note attributes it to guardrail posts, which is not an approval, and the excess is small enough to read as rounding. This leaves the answer balanced.
deciding.handover_decision: scaffold.drawing_ref D-12/A differs from design.drawing_ref D-12/B. That is the one outstanding item (a corrected drawing reference), and the tie test passed.
deciding.limiting_issue: The drawing reference mismatch is the only document gap. There are no defects and the ties and lifts match design, so the structure is recorded as sound.
deciding.discrepancy_size: Height 10.2 m against 10.0 m is 2%, on the edge between levels 0 and 1.
deciding.releasable_share: The 0.2 m excess sits on the top lift from the extended guardrail posts (lift 5 of 5). So 4 of 5 lifts are releasable, and the rest could be released later.
